question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR Reviews entry screen, how is the "Next up · {Month Year}" (next unstarted month) determined from existing snapshots, and what id does a newly-started draft receive — a month-keyed YYYY-MM, the date-keyed YYYY-MM-DD.N scheme used elsewhere, or something else — given the reviews and Published lists are organized by month?
recommendation: Derive "Next up · {Month Year}" purely as a display label — group snapshots by their human `month` field (or the YYYY-MM prefix of each id), find the calendar month after the newest existing review, and show that month with no snapshot yet as the next-up card. But when a draft is actually started, mint its id with the canonical date-keyed `YYYY-MM-DD.N` scheme via `nextDraftId(existingIds, today)` (ADR-003), NOT a month-keyed `YYYY-MM`. Keep the human `month` string (e.g. "August 2026") on the snapshot to drive the by-month grouping of the Reviews/Published lists; the id and the month label are separate concerns.
supporting_points: ADR-003 is explicit and enforced repo-wide: snapshot ids are date-keyed `YYYY-MM-DD.N` (numeric `.N` sequence), and month-keyed `YYYY-MM` is only a *legacy* form 'retained so old snapshots still load' (see src/lib/data.ts compareSnapshotId/nextDraftId, src/lib/date.ts, CONTEXT.md, scripts/dev-write-plugin.ts). Every real committed snapshot and every code path that creates a new draft (DefaultView 'Save' computes 'today's next YYYY-MM-DD.N id') uses the date-keyed scheme, so a newly-started MBR draft should too — reusing a bare `YYYY-MM` id would collide with the legacy form and break the numeric ordering.

Month is a display/label attribute, not an identifier: Snapshot carries both `id` (e.g. '2026-07-27.0') and a human `month` label (e.g. 'August 2026'); MbrBuilderView renders the heading from `snapshot.month` while writing files by `snapshot.id`. So organizing the Reviews/Published lists 'by month' should key off the `month` label (or the id's YYYY-MM date prefix, which is available since ids sort lexically by date), while the started draft keeps a distinct date-keyed id — one snapshot per started month, but identified by day, not month.

There is currently NO implemented 'MBR Reviews entry screen', 'Next up' string, or by-month reviews/Published list in the repo (App.tsx routes are only default/model/locked/edit/mbr; grep for 'Next up'/'Reviews'/'nextUp' finds nothing in src). The only 'next unstarted' precedent is the dev MbrBuilder, which resumes the single latest on-disk draft (latestOnDiskDraft) or re-seeds from the live roster — it does not pick a next month by name. So 'Next up · {Month Year}' must be newly designed as a computed next-calendar-month label over existing snapshots, and it should mint the draft through the existing nextDraftId(existingIds, today) helper to stay consistent with ADR-003 rather than inventing a month-keyed id.
